backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profile auth, order creation with total calculation, and storage using access control and mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files including pages, components, state, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base and theme variables defining OKLCH color system and dark mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router, auth flow, profile setup modal, and global layout with theme provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with Aura MC branding and Discord support link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with animated branding, auth controls, user profile display, and cart subtotal with item count.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name before using the app.
frontend/src/data/products.ts: Defines Product, Category, and Subcategory interfaces and exports a structured list of categories with nested products.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor using React Query, updating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider with login, logout, and identity loading using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profile retrieval, profile saving, order creation, and fetching orders via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme variables and custom background components including Minecraft-style textures.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart UI with item management, pricing, and checkout routing based on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays category products, handles subcategory selection, and supports adding items to the cart with UI icons and bundles.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements the checkout form, validates user inputs, converts cart items to order items, and submits an order before redirecting to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the storefront homepage with hero banner, Discord link, and category grid using cart state for item count.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Fetches and displays order details by ID, handling loading and error states and showing purchased items and buyer info.
frontend/src/state/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with persistence, providing add, remove, update, clear, and total calculation utilities.
frontend/src/utils/inr.ts: Formats numbers as INR currency strings and parses formatted INR values back into numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, animations, and enabling plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Defines the current Aura MC store project state, including goals for a Minecraft-themed INR/UPI-only storefront, homepage requirements, catalog structure, cart/checkout flow, and design notes. Lists architectural rules, existing implemented features, and version metadata.
